sampling_method: Proportional random sampling (Option A) from 26,068 SpotifyCares customer tweets. Sampled proportionally to the keyword-labeled intent distribution with a minimum floor of 3 per intent. 20 tweets reserved for other/ambiguous category. Random seed 42 for reproducibility.
labeling_method: Each tweet was read individually and assigned a gold intent label, difficulty rating (easy/medium/hard), and a short note explaining the labeling reasoning. Labels were assigned based on the primary customer intent, not surface keywords. For example, "cant log in on my iphone" was labeled account_access (not device_compatibility) because the core issue is login, not the device.
key_finding: Keyword labels disagreed with gold labels on 97/200 tweets (48%). The largest source of error was device_compatibility absorbing tweets about account access, billing, playback, and content availability whenever a device name appeared in the text.
